behavior: NativeMemoryOwner retains an immutable unquoted lease. Future checked storage promotion can drop only its own handles, never revoke authority from escaped descendants.

Idle executable inspection retains target parameter storage, dormant prediction resources and exact sources; decoder storage is separate. Parameter-overlay original/published aliases deduplicate across enclosing inventory.
Session-payload inventory explicitly classifies optional processors, communicators, target-only native worlds and erased test owners as incomplete when no complete storage projection exists.

Full nonstate idle coverage remains unknown because parameter traversal omits generated numerical operator helpers, including scaled and elementwise rotary frequency arrays. Partial parameter publication remains behind unquoted authority.

Session entry acquires model and backend-context domain authority before reset, input creation, model execution, cache work and observation. Operation-created payloads retain that authority through failure and session retirement; displaced state takes operation authority with it.

Direct prefill/decode submissions import exact request retention, independently of a sampler. Completed output backing receives only native authority and neutral reservation handles, so raw aliases preserve charges without retaining the session or creating tensor cycles.

Deferred native allocation attachment is cold. A shared descriptor keeps a payload-free owner bundle before evaluation; native or certified host backing receives it before kernel use. Shared buffers, donation, late aliases, failed submission and pending workers retain authority through physical retirement.

Ordinary activation, replica, generated, routing, routed-unit and intervention callbacks retain deferred allocation authority before exposing arrays. Skipped factories stay skipped. Internal no-op prefill does not attach observer owners.
limits: Strict public native budgets still return UnknownBound. Four positive public success regressions remain explicitly ignored; synthetic helper reservations do not establish public native byte bounds.
Complete read-only operator helper traversal, full model/session inventory, safe ownership promotion, actual public request admission and identity-backed opening-state handoff remain required.

Reservation lifetime is not operation authorization. Span identity, geometry, frontier, phase and readout checks do not authorize later instrumentation, arbitrary callbacks, sampling changes, independent copies or accumulation of raw outputs.
Multiple escaped low-level outputs cannot reuse one transient span allowance. Their current backing attachment keeps charges alive but does not establish a cumulative byte quote.
Installed prediction observers, independently allocated callback arrays never returned, standalone sampler escapes and delivered host capture/projection records need their own complete accounting.

Paging/materialization, media preparation and distributed transfers/rank admission still need complete quotes and lifetime integration. No missing implementation is classified as an architectural limitation.

The expanded distributed run was deliberately terminated after one complete dense matrix and 20 single-process passes. Its routed matrix was incomplete and is not counted as validated. Focused single-process native cases were subsequently rerun to terminal success.
Portable contracts and model equations did not change in this increment. No portable suite or pinned released-checkpoint numerics/peak-memory measurements were rerun.
The final feature build has 17 unused-helper warnings, including inventory hooks pending admission integration. Native test linking retains the existing large unwind-table warning.

The exact-capacity fixture now uses chunk size one so capacity-minus-one cannot legitimately succeed by shrinking the chunk.
Certified host-transfer descriptor inspection requires evaluating the returned handles before allocation_info; the tested lazy view remains unmaterialized at deferred attachment.
Outgoing state authority merge required an explicit mutable SessionPayload reborrow through OrdinaryRetirement.
A test-only Weak retirement probe was created before exclusive Rc access. Moving its creation after native submission preserves the actual retirement assertion without preventing Rc::get_mut.

Existing preparation/snapshot owner-count expectations now include the newly retained operation-context owner; the reserved-copy fixture uses its original domain for setup instead of bypassing legitimate context ownership.

The new singleton communicator fixture needed an explicit bounded completion policy. Source alias dedup is tested independently of target parameter inventory, which can be unknown for lazy GGUF arrays.
